name: context-meter
description: Keeps long sessions cheap. /handoff writes a handoff in one turn and swaps the conversation in place for it (no /clear; background agents keep reporting). Hands off by itself between turns: after a push or merge on a big context, before the prompt cache lapses on an idle one, and when a session is running on its own. Speaks once at the handoff mark and near usage limits; /ctx shows size, limits and cost.

handoffAt.title: Handoff mark (tokens)
handoffAt.description: Past this context size, hand off at the next boundary (a push or merge, a long idle, or a run going on its own).

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Where /handoff writes <project>-handoff.md. ~ is your home folder.

autoHandoff.title: Automatic handoffs
autoHandoff.description: Hand off by itself between turns: after a push or merge past the handoff mark, after 50 minutes idle on 200k+, and when a turn started by an agent report, another session or a schedule ends past the mark while you haven't typed for 15 minutes. Off: only /handoff.
